verdict.rationale: Zapier's own docs say developers can embed its automation into their product so customers can connect apps and run automations 'under your brand' without leaving the app. The Workflow API is positioned to power a built-in automation experience or integration marketplace. Evidence is limited to short marketing-level statements, with no detailed white-label documentation or hands-on reports. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on white-label customization and branding controls, embedding implementation details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the automation platform white-label inside my own product for my customers

citations.quote: Embed Zapier's automation capabilities directly into your product so users can connect apps and run automations under your brand.
Bring Zapier’s automation into your own product so customers can build workflows and run actions without leaving your app.
Use Zapier's Workflow API and 9,000 integrations to power a built-in automation experience, integration marketplace, or AI workflows.
